answer: A bond is refunded only after 39 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The vertex counter is kept in comet and river publishes each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 39 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 216 aliases cost 92 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
